goal: Warn RPC callers about obsolete watch-only options before removing them completely
Prevents callers from relying on parameters that have had no effect for multiple releases
agreement: Verified all affected RPCs accept the deprecated options under the deprecation flag (seduless)
Verified remaining occurrences in wallet RPCs and ran functional tests on macOS (enessubass)
Open question regarding future plans for positional arguments (willcl-ark)

why: P3 because this is standard deprecation discipline for inert arguments across five RPCs
Downstream consumers receive advance warning before no-op options are removed completely
